<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex81012026-07-0802-40-17" status="unreviewed">3 pa rim gyis pham 1 lar du gsungs ce na
<lb n="11b6"/>
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">'ban</rs> na re 1 char du gsungs te | gsung 1 du ni gsungs mod kyi du ma nyid du so sor go || ces pa bzhin no | zer ro |
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re ryas 'bring 2ra dus 1 du gsungs la dud pa rjzes la gsungs te de nas chom ldan 'das kyis sa kbor nNa po de dag yang dag par dab du dga' bar mdzad pa'i phyir yang sher phyin 'di ston cing ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro || dus 1 mar bsungs pa gang lta'i lta ying lung bstan pa das 'bring ra chad du gsungs blo <lb n="11b7"/> pa'i skyon yong yang ma mdzad pa'i phyir | 
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> na re ma byas par ma grub ste byad stong pa'i don bcan nas | myad stong 'dir don ma ming med | 'dir gzhung bsdus pa yin 'dod de || </seg></TEI>
